questionText: Which of the following statements regarding The Nut Graph in Journalism is INCORRECT / NOT true?

options.text: Its magnitude depends directly on the governing physical or analytical constants of The Nut Graph.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: It exhibits consistent and reproducible behavior across verified experimental measurements.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: It operates in direct violation of the fundamental conservation laws of Journalism.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for The Nut Graph.

options.text: It conforms strictly to the standard equilibrium conditions defined in NCERT Journalism.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
